fields.name: siteUrl
fields.label: Production site URL
fields.description: HTTPS custom domain, without a trailing slash

fields.name: noIndex
fields.label: Keep this page out of search results
fields.description: Use for campaign, thank-you, or utility pages only

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image filename
fields.description: Optional — uses a default image if empty

fields.name: formSlug
fields.label: Form slug
fields.description: The slug of the form to embed (matches a file in src/content/forms/). E.g. 'contact'

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Success message
fields.description: Shown to the user after a successful submission

fields.name: submissionEndpoint
fields.label: Form submission endpoint
fields.description: Required in production. Use a secure external endpoint or a Cloudflare Pages Function URL.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Options (select only)
fields.description: Comma-separated list of options, e.g. 'Option A,Option B,Option C'
